mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.board_id AS boardId, b.name AS boardName, p.user_id AS authorId, COALESCE(up.nickname, su.username) AS author, p.title, p.like_count AS likeCount, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM forum_post p JOIN forum_board b ON p.board_id = b.id AND b.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user su ON p.user_id = su.id AND su.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_profile up ON su.id = up.user_id AND up.deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT p.id, p.board_id AS boardId, b.name AS boardName, p.user_id AS authorId, COALESCE(up.nickname, su.username) AS author, p.title, LEFT(p.content, 100) AS excerpt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_comment fc WHERE fc.post_id = p.id AND fc.deleted = 0) AS replyCount, p.like_count AS likeCount, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM forum_post p JOIN forum_board b ON p.board_id = b.id AND b.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user su ON p.user_id = su.id AND su.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_profile up ON su.id = up.user_id AND up.deleted = 0 WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.board_id = #{boardId}
AND (p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY (p.like_count + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_comment fc WHERE fc.post_id = p.id AND fc.deleted = 0)) DESC, p.create_time DESC
ORDER BY p.create_time DESC

SELECT p.id, p.board_id AS boardId, b.name AS boardName, p.user_id AS authorId, COALESCE(up.nickname, su.username) AS author, p.title, p.content, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_comment fc WHERE fc.post_id = p.id AND fc.deleted = 0) AS replyCount, p.like_count AS likeCount, p.view_count AS viewCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_like fl WHERE fl.post_id = p.id AND fl.user_id = #{currentUserId}) > 0 AS liked, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM forum_post p JOIN forum_board b ON p.board_id = b.id AND b.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user su ON p.user_id = su.id AND su.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_profile up ON su.id = up.user_id AND up.deleted = 0 WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted = 0

SELECT c.id, c.post_id AS postId, c.user_id AS authorId, COALESCE(up.nickname, su.username) AS author, c.content, c.image_url AS imageUrl, c.create_time AS createTime FROM forum_comment c JOIN sys_user su ON c.user_id = su.id AND su.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_profile up ON su.id = up.user_id AND up.deleted = 0 WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.create_time ASC
